text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall, but I should judge each decision by its rationale and risk—not by short-term account movements or the satisfaction of a gain.","Selling part of Stock C at a substantial profit realized a gain while keeping some exposure; I should consider partial trims when they fit my allocation plan rather than selling automatically.","Because losses feel especially painful, I should set clear reasons to hold or sell each position in advance and review them calmly, instead of letting loss aversion or frequent account checks drive trades."]}
